subtext: A version or launch name can organize several features.
title: Assign shared milestones
statement: As a Product Manager, I can assign features to a shared named milestone, so the team can see a common delivery target without duplicating its definition.
overview: A milestone is optional and names an owner-chosen target. It does not imply dates, scheduling or dependency enforcement. Existing free-text milestone values remain readable; new assignments use shared milestone identities.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A feature can have no milestone or one reference to a shared milestone, and several features can reference that same milestone.
Renaming a shared milestone updates its displayed name for every assigned feature without rewriting feature memberships.
Assigning a missing or cross-Saga milestone is rejected without changing the feature plan.
An update omitting the milestone preserves its assignment, while an explicitly empty milestone clears the assignment.
